_: Pustaka Referensi — every style reference Simon has sent, newest first. Built into a page by scripts/vi/ref-library.py and published as an Artifact (URL in the memory file pustaka-referensi.md). Add a reference: put the file under docs/vi-style/refs/, add an item (or a collection) here, rerun the script, republish to the same URL. src is relative to the repo root, or absolute for files outside it.
